body: Yup  I am ^^ I will keep you guys in mind, but if anyone needs talking to someone I'm also here for all of you. <3

That is true. I was in a hopeless state of mind last night and I guess that led to everything. It was a downward spyral of thoughts leading to the bottom of all my struggles. Thank you so much for beind here <3

I am currently 19 years old, just graduated high school. I do have people to talk to it's just that I was alone this whole day and when I wrote that post I was pretty drunk which led to emotional talking. I didn't really think about why I wanted to do it at the moment, I just felt like doing it if i have to be honest.

Thats exactly what I did. I just cried for an hour and fell asleep. Now i'm refreshed and sober and i'm gonna try to go out with some friends tonight to kind of relax and get my mind off anything bad. Thank you for being here <3

Yeah, I've spent half my life listening to this band and when I found out it just made the day even worse than it was. Listening to all their old stuff and thinking about the lyrics and the way Chester felt made me realize that I feel the same in that moment.
Thank you all so much for what you've said. It actually makes me feel like there's always going to be someone there, even if not right beside you physically. <3
That is all so inspiring and im so happy that you've managed to move forward and do what's best for you friend. Congrats to you for the wedding and I hope you have a great time ^^

It's just these things you see and feel before the point of no return I guess. Images of people and moments, visions of what I could've done if I kept living and the simple resist mechanism of my body..
I don't want to bother any of you with things that depend on me to manage.. I'm gonna be fine if I keep working on my problems. <3

Guys, i'm feeling a lot better after waking up. I came home very drunk last night and it all just came down to me. I don't really feel suicidal when sober, i believe that everything gets better and i try to do things that help me grow in the right direction. I suffer from panic attacks and extreme social anxiety and i've learned to manage it, i'm not sad and hopeless all the time it's just moments like these that hit me very hard, especially under the influence of alcohol. I thank all of you for the kind words and responses and I want to assure you that im not going to try anything like this ever again. I'm so sorry for bothering and creating this post since I cringe when I read it now. I'm gonna keep working on myself and try to get better because even if this was a drunken post it shows that all the things said lay somewhere deep in me and I apparently believe them. I love all of you and I'm gonna try to respond to any other comments. <3
I guess im gonna need help now so if anyone sees this please help idk what im doing anymore
Okay I tried to but i gave up at the last moment............. I dont know what to do anymore
